test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

MOBILE : CPNFMJ :: PHONES : PIQTFO :: CHARGE : ?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• MOBILE : CPNFMJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e04df0f478ca48adbef30ba464c8eb1954ae27656bfeb293e156038b06c44d2.png] 

 
• PHONES : PIQTFO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93468f7d3bffd7cfb66d2e39734ff5830469bf072d16da9ebab0ff1feb9d8df3.png] 

 
• Similarly, **CHARGE : BIDFHS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89c8810b08338c92e763b43eacef84e846189de51b0050c033fa645e147466d2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **'BIDFHS'**.
